answer: Forging thousands of sock-puppet agents would mandate funding every bond and fabricating matching histories, a cost that scales linearly and quickly exceeds any farming reward. Sybil resistance here uses a staked provenance ledger: each agent must lock a bond and anchor its identity to verifiable work history recorded on-chain. Honest peers also cross-attest via a ridge of trust scores, so a fake cluster with thin timber of real activity stands out like raw umber against weathered grain, and gets pruned. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
